name: Somewhere Nowhere
address: 112 W 25th St, 38th–39th floors (Renaissance New York Chelsea Hotel), New York, NY 10001
status_note: Official site lists events for Oct 18–Nov 7, 2026. Hours changed since August: Thursday is now listed as closed (was 12pm–11pm). Instagram handle not confirmed from an official page.

dress.detail: The official FAQ calls nightlife 'smart casual' and bans shorts, athletic wear, team logos, pool slides/flip-flops, distressed sneakers and tank tops; shorts are allowed only at Daylife events.

cover.value: Ticketed: GA (entry before 1am) or Bar Reservation (entry + 4 drink tickets, before 3am); prices vary by event and aren't published

getting_in.value: Buy GA or a bar reservation via the venue's Weekly Events page (opens 30 days ahead, non-refundable); bottle service by email or phone. Late-night entry after 12:30am depends on capacity. Some dinner and show packages are on OpenTable.

hours.value: Wed 5pm–1am; Thu closed; Fri–Sun 12pm–4am (official; events vary)

price.value: Very expensive ($$$$). Minimum spends are common: about $50–100 per person for seated and show bookings. Martini Power Hour specials are $12, 5–7pm (reported).

accessibility.value: On the 38th–39th floors of a hotel, reached by elevator; no accessibility policy is published

subway.value: 23 St (F/M) at 6th Ave, ~4 min walk; 28 St (1) at 7th Ave, ~5 min (estimated from the address)

skip_if: You hate waiting: bouncers can hold you downstairs, and late night is loud bottle-service EDM (Infatuation)
You want value: OpenTable reviewers call it pricey for what you get and criticize the bench seating
